name: Free Lunch Lab: Japan’s national cash benefits and subsidies, November 2026
description: Every figure on the roundup of Japan’s national cash benefits: amounts, who gets them, dates and periods for each benefit or subsidy, each with its status (running, in a bill, under consideration, reported only, not decided or not planned, ended), source, source name in Japanese and English, and check date.
license: CC BY 4.0 (figures from the government, Diet, municipal and news sources named in each entry)
about: Figures behind the roundup of Japan's national cash benefits and subsidies, /guides/japan-benefits-2026/. Each fact gives its value, the benefit it belongs to (item), the date or period it refers to, its status (running: decided and running; bill: in a bill before the Diet; considering: the government says it is considering it; reported: reported by the press only; none: not decided or not planned; ended), the source URL with its name in Japanese and English, and the day it was checked. Facts shared with the Worker Burden Relief Payment page name the fact in worker-relief-2026.json under 'wrp' and have the same value and source. build.js checks that every language of the page carries the digits listed under 'digits' (any one of the alternatives in each nested list).
